item.title: RGB LED Strip Lampu LED Lampu Hias Strip USB Kamar Dekorasi Rumah Lampu 1/2/3/4/5/10/15 M Lampu Belakang TV
item.description:
‼Catatan: Setelah menerima barang, harap sambungkan dan uji untuk penggunaan normal sebelum membuka dan menempelkannya di dinding atau di belakang TV.



 Features :
16 MILLION COLORS: 16 million colors that create different atmospheres, the LED light bar can be used for TV/PC/Laptop backlight.
Safer to use: TV backlight operates at 5v voltage, 5v power bank for strip light use. Very low heat, touchable and safe for children.
EASY INSTALLATION: Cornered wiring makes installation easier. It will bend at an angle without adding additional connectors or breaking the bar.
App Control: Completely control your light on your mobile device with the app. HappyLighting via Bluetooth, by setting a timer on APP, you can turn on/off this light at a specific time. It's dimmable and has multiple dynamic modes to create an exciting visual experience.

 Specifications :
1.Voltan: DC 5v 1A
2. Color: RGB Red, Green & Blue
3.LED value: 18led /M
4. Chanka Hayat 50,000 sneezes
5.USB length:30cm
6. Suitable length:
1M is suitable for a 22-inch TV;
2M is suitable for 23-32 inch TVs;
3M is suitable for 33-43 inch TVs;
4M is suitable for 44-60 inch TVs.

Application:
 Ideal for decorating your home creating atmosphere or light show horizontal illumination
 RGB strip lights add a romantic, relaxing, dynamic, magical or festive atmosphere in the dining room, bedroom, upstairs, kitchen, balcony, terrace, deck, patio, pergola, pavilion, office, dorm, cafe, bistro, bar, restaurant, event venue, Pickup, RV, Camping
 A great festival gift for your family or friends.

Note:

2. The remote is not included because it is a control app.
3.Please note that only 10 m and 15 m have a remote control, the others are controlled by APP directly.
